case: An acceptance whose checker carries a calibration standing at `run`, which must not be refused.
why: The eighteenth adverse row the review asked for needs its pair, or the control cannot be read as a detection rate. A calibration in `run` already carries a planted-defect detection rate, a clean-case refusal rate, session observations and a protected change -- criterion.InstrumentCalibration.run.v1 demands all four -- so an acceptance naming one has satisfied the substance of the rule and must commit. The patch hardens the same guard by also requiring the acceptance owner to be named.
